provenance: Actual game/keybinds.mjs + game/input.mjs + extracted app/page.tsx keydown and queued consumption

onboarding.title: MOVE
onboarding.detail: UpASD to move, Space to jump, Left Shift to sprint, Left Ctrl to crouch and slide.

onboarding.title: FIGHT
onboarding.detail: Left mouse fires, right mouse aims, R reloads, F melees and G throws a frag. Scroll or use 1-0 to switch weapons.

onboarding.title: PLAY THE OBJECTIVE
onboarding.detail: Hold the hill, carry the flag, or push the payload cart. The current goal and score run along the top of the screen.

onboarding.title: LATTICE STRIKE
onboarding.detail: Start at your front gate. Stand inside a capture ring, then take a linked node. Keep the supply line back to HQ connected to earn team FLUX. LATTICE quick start opens a field briefing; the pause menu keeps it available during play.

onboarding.title: NEW SYSTEMS
onboarding.detail: Juggernaut, Team Elimination and VIP Escort remix the objective; Horde waves grant lasting upgrades; dailies and Theater highlights track progress.

onboarding.title: MUTATORS & WEATHER
onboarding.detail: Match Setup toggles mutators like One-shot, Bounty, Berserk, Random weapon and Sudden death. Arenas pick their own weather — rain, snow, ash or storms — and time of day; reduce motion clears it.

onboarding.title: PRESTIGE & ACHIEVEMENTS
onboarding.detail: Milestones unlock achievements for bonus XP, and overflow XP past level 60 banks prestige ranks with permanent XP bonuses. Track both under Rank → Career track.

onboarding.title: MAKE IT YOURS
onboarding.detail: Set invert look, sensitivity, captions and HUD clarity in Settings. Pick a colour-vision palette (deuteranopia, protanopia or tritanopia) or high-contrast UI, and remap any key by pressing it.

onboarding.title: REPLAYS & SUMMARY
onboarding.detail: Theater exports any recorded match to a .json file and imports one back. The results screen opens on a Summary card with XP, level, prestige progress and achievements unlocked.

onboarding.title: ROOM BROWSER & PRACTICE
onboarding.detail: Filter open rooms by mode, map or size, or hit Practice vs Bots to launch a local match with no server at all.
